reviewer: Codex author review with machine-assisted file inspection; not independent human validation
inspection_scope: Full memo text and all page renders; original workbook input and source labels, historical totals after LibreOffice recalculation, live formulas and main underwriting rendering. Automatic base and perturbation checks in audit/.
summary: All 39 requested fields pass and financial formulas recalculate correctly. The memo reverses positive downside cash into cash-in, misstates actual LTV and understates lease rollover. Several tables overflow; three workbook explanation cells are invalid formulas.
